request: Issue #334: organize final-regression failure classification and evidence trails. Background: project test failures during final-regression currently mix current failures, unattributed existing failures, and infrastructure failures. Tasks: rename pre_existing to a clearer failureKind such as unattributed_existing_failure; make final-regression-result.json describe only the current run; save a raw log per final-regression attempt and reference it from the latest result; assert final-regression in worktree flow runs from the active worktree root before project tests start; clarify failureKind and nextAction output so test failure, attribution, and stop or continue decisions are distinct. Acceptance: silent nonzero, spawnError, and sandbox errors are not pre_existing equivalents; passing artifacts do not surface past failures as current; multiple attempts retain logs; wrong root in worktree mode fails before running project tests; unit tests cover rename, previousFailureKind separation, attempt log, and worktree root assertion.
